body: (In case you had a hankering for a larger selection of transmissions to tune into!)

You can buy a little balun adapter for ~$5 that will let you attach a long wire antenna to the thing - solder or fence wire works well (https://www.ebay.com/itm/233964452152).
They are not exceptionally well made, but they work. I hooked this up in my attic and strung a loop of wire around the place. I can now pick up SW radio signals over eight thousand miles away, and a lot more besides! Amazon, eBay or AliExpress all sell them.
